history.prompt: Extreme close-up macro photograph, 100mm macro lens, one razor-sharp focal plane. A complex server logic board with a vibrant, tangled copper bypass wire looping aggressively back onto itself multiple times. Shallow depth of field, visible surface texture, dust particles, soft directional daylight catching brushed metal components. The tangled wire sits off-centre on the thirds, the background falling away into soft, dark shadows. High-end editorial photography, sophisticated muted palette with one amber glowing accent.

style_when: the story is about change after hours — automation displacing shifts, a market open all night, capacity running while people sleep
prompt: Landscape composition (16:9): wide framing with generous editorial negative space, asymmetric composition where the massive hero structure commands the frame off-centre. Architectural photograph of a modern data center building at blue hour, shot on an anamorphic 35mm wide lens. The clean geometry of the facility features a relentless, repeating grid of lit windows emitting a warm amber light against the deep blue ambient twilight, indicating automated capacity running while people sleep. Long-exposure calm with no moving figures, deep shadows, textured matte concrete, small human scale implied by a single illuminated doorway. Editorial restraint, sophisticated cool and warm color palette.
negative_prompt: text, typography, letters, numbers, watermark, logo, signage, human faces, people, UI
rationale: The runaway cloud bill and unmonitored agent loop perfectly fit the architectural_night treatment, illustrating relentless automated capacity consuming resources after hours without human oversight.
subject: a modern data center exterior at dusk
alt_text: A modern data center building at dusk with a repeating grid of warm glowing windows.
caption: Unmonitored agent retries can trigger endless compute loops, racking up massive cloud bills overnight.
title: Runaway Agent Compute Facility
